members.name: value
members.doc: The document, when the application controls it. The editor normalizes it, and an edit reports through `onChange`.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The first document, when the editor manages its own. It is normalized: a value that is not a document, or has nothing left after normalizing, becomes one empty paragraph.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the normalized document after an edit the editor accepts. It does not run at mount, when `disabled` or `readOnly` changes, or when `value` changes from outside.

members.name: label
members.doc: The visible label, which names the editable content.

members.name: description
members.doc: Help text below the content, which describes it.

members.name: errorMessage
members.doc: The error text below the content. Setting it also marks the content invalid and names the text as its error message.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the editor and its toolbar.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Keeps the content readable but not editable.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks the content required.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the content invalid.

members.name: placeholder
members.doc: The text shown while the document is empty.

members.name: limit
members.doc: The most characters of plain text the document may hold; a fraction is rounded down, and a negative, infinite, or omitted limit means no limit. An edit past it is refused and not reported.

members.name: toolbar
members.doc: `simple` or `advanced` shows that toolbar, `floating` shows the simple one as a floating bar, and `false` shows none.

members.name: floating
members.doc: Floats the toolbar over the content.

members.name: bubbleMenu
members.doc: Shows a formatting menu while text is selected.

members.name: onLinkRequest
members.doc: Called instead of the link prompt, with the actions that apply the address.

members.name: onImageRequest
members.type: (actions: { insertImage(src: string, alt?: string): boolean }) => void
members.doc: Called instead of the image prompt, with the action that inserts the image.

members.name: onColorRequest
members.doc: Called instead of applying a picked color, with the action that applies it.

members.name: onGenerate
members.doc: Called by the Generate with AI action. Returning `false` reports that nothing happened.

members.name: selectionActions
members.doc: Actions in the selection bar. Enabled with `onSelectionRequest`.

members.name: selectionInstruction
members.doc: Shows the "Describe edits" field in the selection bar. Defaults to true.

members.name: onSelectionRequest
members.doc:
Called when an action or instruction is sent. A returned promise shows the pending state; a rejection shows
a failure message with Try again and Dismiss.

members.name: autoFocus
members.doc: Focuses the editable content once it is in the page, without scrolling, when the editor is editable. Only the first mount reads it.

members.name: onReady
members.doc: Called once the editable content is in the page and can take focus. It renders on the client after mount, so this runs after hydration.

members.name: onFormattingChange
members.doc: Called with the formatting at the selection when the editor is ready, then whenever a selection move or an edit changes it.

members.name: minRows
members.doc: The least height of the content, in lines of its text. A fraction is rounded down, and a value below 1 means the default height.

members.name: maxRows
members.doc: The greatest height of the content, in lines of its text, beyond which it scrolls. It is rounded as minRows is and never less than minRows.

members.name: preset
members.doc:
`rich` holds all the editor's formatting. `markdown` limits it to what Markdown holds: no underline, color, font or
alignment. They are not in its document, so a paste loses them, their commands return false, and no tool or shortcut
offers them; the toolbar shows Strikethrough in place of Underline. Only the first mount reads it.

members.name: markdown
members.doc:
Makes the value Markdown text, read and reported through this object in place of `value`, `defaultValue` and `onChange`,
with the `markdown` preset. Pasted plain text is read as Markdown. Only the first mount reads whether it is set.

exports.name: isTextEditorDocument
exports.doc: True for Mux's finite portable editor document grammar.

exports.name: normalizeTextEditorUrl
exports.doc:
The address as the link or image command stores it, or null when that command would refuse it: the same rule the document
grammar applies. A link takes an absolute http, https, or mailto URL and an image an absolute http or https URL, with no
user name or password, no surrounding space, and no control character. The result is the URL's normalized form, such as
`https://example.com/` for `https://example.com`.

exports.name: fromMarkdown
exports.doc:
Reads Markdown (CommonMark plus GFM `~~strike~~`) into a TextEditor document that `isTextEditorDocument` accepts. It is
pure and synchronous and needs no DOM, so it runs on a server. Raw HTML and syntax outside the editor's grammar stay
literal text, and a link or image address the editor would refuse is dropped with its text kept. The module header
lists everything the conversion normalizes.

exports.name: toMarkdown
exports.doc:
Writes a TextEditor document as Markdown (CommonMark plus GFM `~~strike~~`) that `fromMarkdown` reads back as the same
document, once the losses in the module header are applied. It is pure and synchronous and needs no DOM. Underline,
colour, fonts, sizes and alignment are dropped, as Markdown cannot hold them, and so are addresses the editor would
refuse. There is no trailing newline; an empty document gives an empty string.

members.doc: True for a caret, false while text or a block is selected.

members.type: { readonly bold: boolean; readonly italic: boolean; readonly underline: boolean; readonly strike: boolean; readonly code: boolean }
members.doc: Each mark is true when all the selected text carries it, or at a caret when the next typed text would.

members.name: link
members.doc: The address of the link at a caret, the one the next typed text would take, or of the one link all the selected text is in; otherwise null.

members.name: block
members.doc: The kind of text block that holds the selection, or null when it spans more than one kind or holds no text block.

members.name: headingLevel
members.doc: The level of the headings the selection is in, when they share one; otherwise null.

members.name: list
members.doc: The nearest list that holds the whole selection, or null.

members.name: quote
members.doc: True when a quote holds the whole selection.

members.doc:
Focuses the editable content with its selection. By default focus follows a frame later and scrolls the selection into
view; `preventScroll` focuses at once and scrolls nothing.

members.name: pendingLabel
members.doc: Text shown while the request runs. Defaults to "Editing…".

members.name: overflow
members.doc: Shown only after "More actions" expands the bar.

types.name: TextEditorSelectionActions

members.name: selection
members.type: { readonly text: string; readonly document: TextEditorDocument }
members.doc: The selected text and content when the request started.

members.name: signal
members.doc: Aborts on Escape or Cancel, an edit or formatting change of the selected range, a new request, `close()`, and unmount.

members.name: replace
members.doc:
Replaces the selection and starts the Keep, Discard, and Try again review.
A string is plain text that takes the formatting at the start of the selection and turns line breaks into
hard breaks; a document keeps its own formatting. Only the first successful edit of a request applies.
Returns false when the request is stale or aborted, the editor is disabled or read-only, `limit` would be
exceeded, or the content is invalid.

members.name: insertAfter
members.doc:
Like `replace`, but leaves the selection in place. A string is inserted right after the selection with the
formatting at the start of the selection; a document is inserted as blocks after the block that holds the end
of the selection.

members.name: close
members.doc: Ends the request and hides the bar until the selection changes, keeping any applied edit.
